headline: Brazil Agricultural Revenue Projected to Fall 2.6% to $248 Billion in 2026
summary: Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture projects total domestic farm revenue will decline 2.6% to $248 billion in 2026, citing lower receipts for coffee, cocoa, and oranges.
why: Brazil is a world-leading exporter of agricultural commodities. Farm income declines impact Latin America's largest economy, export tax collections, and global soft commodity supplies.

impacts.name: Brazil
impacts.why: Lower agricultural output revenue contracts primary sector earnings across Brazilian rural regions.
